description:
README.md:239-241:

  'A tree-backed MockBackend exists in the test_support module inside src/lib.rs for unit testing only; it is not suitable for production use.'

This was written before commit c30d7ed extracted MemoryBackend to src/memory.rs behind feature='memory'. The current state:

- src/lib.rs:124-458 still has test_support::MockBackend (#[cfg(test)] — internal only, not pub).
- src/memory.rs provides memory::MemoryBackend (#[cfg(feature='memory')] — public reference impl).

The README mentions neither the feature flag nor MemoryBackend. A downstream contributor reading the README will not know:
1. That feature='memory' exists.
2. That MemoryBackend is the public reference impl they should be looking at.
3. That MockBackend is private and not the intended example.

Required edits:
- Remove the MockBackend mention (or rewrite to clarify it is cfg(test)-only and not the public reference).
- Add a 'Memory feature' or 'Reference implementation' section pointing to MemoryBackend and the feature gate.

Also: README.md:6-9 still describes the crate well, but lines 233-241 ('Gotchas' section) should mention the JMAP-510h.4/5/6 silent-failure cases as known limitations, OR those bugs should be fixed (preferred).
title: README.md is stale: claims test_support module exists 'inside src/lib.rs' but the canonical reference impl is now memory::MemoryBackend
